title: 1996 Yugioh Gradius PSV-089 1st Edition Common Machine
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: It is a vintage 1996 Yugioh trading card featuring the character Gradius. This Common Monster card has an Attack/Power of 1200 and a Defense/Toughness of 800. It is from the Pharaoh's Servant (PSV) set, with card number PSV-089. The card is in English, made of card stock material, and manufactured by Konami in the United States. This 1st Edition card is part of the Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG game and is considered a collectible item.
